upheavals.title: The Great Storm
upheavals.text: A storm rips through town. Trees down, roofs gone, everyone's hair ruined.

effects.text: A flying wheelie bin hits you.
Your roof now has a skylight. You did not order one.

upheavals.title: Flu Season From Hell
upheavals.text: A flu sweeps through town. The pharmacy runs out of tissues by noon.

effects.text: You catch the flu. Everything hurts, especially your dignity.

upheavals.title: The Market Crashes
upheavals.text: The stock market crashes. Grown adults are seen crying at the cash machine.

effects.text: Your savings shrink. Your pension fund sends a sad emoji.
You check your bank app eleven times an hour.

upheavals.title: Town Festival!
upheavals.text: The town festival begins: free sausages, terrible music and a pie contest nobody takes lightly.

effects.text: Free sausages and terrible music. You love it.

upheavals.title: Blackout
upheavals.text: The power goes out across town. No lights, no Wi-Fi, no meaning.

effects.text: No Wi-Fi. You have to talk to your own thoughts.
